comment: CISG (SR 0.221.211.1, ratified treaty, court calls it Swiss federal law) relabelled OTHER_LAW -> STATUTE. #50 'Art. 3 Abs. 1 und Art. 4' of the Hague Convention (title only) kept as one BARE_ARTICLE chain span; guideline does not say whether BARE_ARTICLE chains are split. Two appeals: item 1 Verfassungsbeschwerde nicht eingetreten (inadmissible), item 2 Beschwerde in Zivilsachen abgewiesen (dismissed); took item 1 per rule.
